en.title: Boundary of the Afterglow: Sanctuary of Ghosts and the Cliff of Vows
en.premise: In a 'vanished village' erased from the maps by the tide of modernization, four individuals driven by conflicting senses of justice find their paths entwined. An ambitious merchant hunting for the village's legacy; a former soldier seeking the truth of her birthplace; an elderly hermit guarding the village's fading memories; and a young veteran returning to fulfill a long-forgotten vow. At the 'Hill of Promise,' where childhood friends once swore an oath, they must confront their own inner turmoil. Caught between lost memories and a changing era, they are finally exposed to the cruel light of truth.

zh.title: 残照之境界 ―亡灵之圣域与誓约之断崖―
zh.premise: 在近代化的浪潮中被吞噬、从地图上消失的“失落之村”，四名持有不同正义观的男女在此交汇。追求村庄遗产的野心商人，追寻故乡真相的前军人女性，守护村庄记忆的隐居老人，以及试图履行约定而归来的年轻士兵。在昔日青梅竹马们立誓的“约定之丘”上，他们将面对各自的内心挣扎。在失落的记忆与变迁的时代之间，他们终将沐浴在名为“真相”的残酷之光中。
